items.title: How to Write Effective OKRs
items.summary: OKRs are a goal-setting framework used to define measurable goals and track progress. They consist of two key things: Objectives and Key Results. OKRs are tools to drive focus and alignment, and should evolve with the organization. A common mistake is treating OKRs as a checklist of tasks. Index OKRs using labels like O1, KR1, KR2, KR3, etc.
